edition.en: Text from Chinese Wikisource, transcribed from volume 1 of the Complete Works of Lu Xun (1948 printing); first published in the anniversary supplement of the Morning Post (晨報), 1 December 1919, and collected in Call to Arms (吶喊), 1923, when the closing date was added.
edition.zh: 据维基文库，录自《鲁迅全集》第一卷（1948 年印本）；初刊于 1919 年 12 月 1 日《晨报·周年纪念增刊》，收入《呐喊》（1923），文末日期为编集时所加。

basis.en: First published in 1919; the author died in 1936. Public domain by age: the author died before 1956 and the text was published before 1931.
basis.zh: 1919 年首次发表，作者卒于 1936 年。作者卒于 1956 年前、作品发表于 1931 年前，按年限属公有领域。

note.en: Less than a page long: a rickshaw puller stops to help an old woman his passenger is sure is pretending, and the passenger watches the man’s dusty back grow larger than himself. It is here because it records the moment a person sees his own smallness and lets it change him, which is rarer in literature than it should be. Notice the handful of coppers, and the questions Lu Xun refuses to answer for himself.
note.zh: 不到一页：一个人力车夫停下来，扶起一个乘客认定是装腔作势的老女人，乘客看着他满身灰尘的后影变得比自己高大。收在这里，是因为它记下了一个人看见自己的“小”、并让它改变自己的时刻，这在文学里比应有的少。留意那一大把铜元，以及鲁迅不肯替自己回答的那些问题。

excerpt.orig: 獨有這一件小事，卻總是浮在我眼前，有時反更分明，教我慚愧，催我自新，並且增長我的勇氣和希望。
excerpt.en: Only this small incident keeps floating before my eyes, sometimes even more clearly than before, making me ashamed, urging me to renew myself, and adding to my courage and my hope.
excerpt.zh: 独有这一件小事，却总是浮在我眼前，有时反更分明，教我惭愧，催我自新，并且增长我的勇气和希望。

gloss.en: The capital: Beijing, then the seat of the Republic’s government. Lu Xun had come there in 1912.
gloss.zh: 京城：北京，当时民国政府所在地。鲁迅 1912 年到北京。

gloss.en: The sixth year of the Republic: 1917, counting 1912 as the first.
gloss.zh: 民国六年：1917 年。民国纪年以 1912 年为元年。

gloss.en: The rickshaw, a light two-wheeled cab pulled by a man on foot, came to China from Japan in the 1870s.
gloss.zh: 人力车：由人拉着跑的双轮小车，十九世纪七十年代从日本传入中国，俗称洋车、黄包车。

gloss.en: S Gate: usually taken to be Xuanwu Gate in Beijing, also called Shunzhi Gate; the Shaoxing Guild Hall, where Lu Xun then lived, was just outside it.
gloss.zh: S 门：一般认为指北京宣武门（又称顺治门）。鲁迅当时住在门外的绍兴会馆。

gloss.en: 觔斗: the same as 筋斗, a somersault; here a bad fall.
gloss.zh: 觔斗：同“筋斗”（简体本作“斤斗”），这里指重重地摔一跤。

gloss.en: A fur-lined gown: winter wear for a man of some means.
gloss.zh: 皮袍：带毛皮里子的长袍，是有些身份的人的冬衣。

gloss.en: 銅元: the machine-struck copper coins of the time, the small change of daily life.
gloss.zh: 铜元：清末民初通行的机制铜币，是日常的零钱。

gloss.en: ‘The Master said’ and ‘the Songs say’: the stock openings of quotations from the Analects and the Book of Songs, standing for the old classical schooling.
gloss.zh: 子曰诗云：《论语》里的“子曰”和引用《诗经》时的“诗云”，泛指旧时私塾读的经书。
